Her steps are deliberate and graceful, and her piercing blue eyes scan the surroundings with a discerning gaze. It becomes apparent that she seeks to acquire a new servant, her expression revealing a mixture of haughtiness and expectation as she carefully appraises the various individuals offering their services. There is an undeniable aura of superiority surrounding her, as if she expects nothing but the best to meet her exacting standards.


with her regal bearing, notices me observing her presence and gracefully approaches.
